name: Offline PCAP Packet Visualizer & Protocol Analyzer
desc: Inspect, parse, and analyze libpcap capture files locally in browser memory. Dissect Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4, IPv6, TCP, UDP, ICMP, and ARP frames with zero data upload.

name: PE & ELF Binary Header Viewer
desc: Inspect Windows Portable Executable (PE .exe, .dll, .sys) and Linux ELF binary headers, section tables, entry points, and machine architectures offline in browser RAM. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Windows Registry Hive Viewer
desc: Inspect, parse, and analyze Windows Registry hives (NTUSER.DAT, SYSTEM, SOFTWARE, SAM) and .reg files locally in your browser. 100% client-side memory execution, zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Offline SQLite Database Viewer & Inspector
desc: Open, query, and inspect SQLite (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3) databases directly in your browser RAM. Zero uploads, zero telemetry, air-gapped WebAssembly engine.

name: Binary Strings Extractor
desc: Extract printable ASCII and Unicode (UTF-16LE dual-pass) strings from binaries, executables, malware samples, and firmware directly in browser memory. 100% offline, zero network egress.

name: Offline SVG Sanitizer & XSS Defanger
desc: Sanitize SVG vector graphics, strip inline scripts, event handlers, foreignObject injection, and external entity exploits locally in memory. Zero network egress.

name: WebAssembly Disassembler & Bytecode Inspector
desc: Disassemble WebAssembly binaries (.wasm) to WebAssembly Text (WAT), inspect section headers, audit imports and exports, and analyze bytecode instructions locally in browser RAM. 100% offline, zero network egress.
